title: SectorProfile
description: Schema for T5.3 sector profile YAML files loaded by C6 — Sector Profile Manager. Activated via VIGILANCE_SECTOR environment variable.

sector.description: Sector identifier. Maps to VIGILANCE_SECTOR env var.

schema_extensions.description: Additional fields injected into CanonicalEvent for this sector.

tool_plugins.description: C4 adapter plugin names to activate for this sector.

policy_templates.description: OPA/Rego policy template names available to C3 for this sector.

llm_system_prompt.description: System prompt injected into C2 agentic loop for this sector's LLM persona.

ot_safety_flag.description: When true, C5 applies additional OT safety gate checks (Siemens INDUSTRY_4 only).

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum agent confidence required for APPROVED guardrail verdict.

protected_ranges.description: CIDR ranges that must not be targeted by automated actions. Events from these IPs escalate to human review.
